description: Every descending sequence of nonzero classes modulo finite subsets of the naturals has a nonzero common lower bound.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.descending_nonzero_lower_bound
  (q : ℕ → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.FiniteQuotient) (hd : Antitone q) (hn : ∀ (n : ℕ), q n ≠ ⊥) :
  ∃ r, r ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), r ≤ q n
